thread:
devin (prod): Quick flag - finance pilot wants multi-region tenant isolation earlier. They're asking for a hardened routing policy + migration window. Can we scope a minimal MVP?

maria (PM): Minimal MVP = region-tagged routing + hard fallback + rollout automation. Need explicit launch gates.

emma (arch): Proposal for gates:
- routing policy DSL v0 (region, tier, fallback)
- tenancy slices: up to 5 pilot tenants boxed into a single slice
- per-tenant encryption keys + KMS integration
- observability: per-route P50/P95/P99 and token cost

rick (sre): Also add: automated circuit-breakers when cross-region egress > budget threshold.

sonia (cs): Customer will accept pilot if we guarantee a rollback plan and a dedicated slack channel. They're ok with limited tenant count.

devin (prod): Can we commit to timing? Rough engineering estimate?

emma (arch): Engineering: routing template + policy engine ~2 sprints. KMS + tenant keys ~1 sprint. Rollout tooling & canary ~1 sprint. Total ~4 sprints if parallelized.

maria (PM): Launch acceptance checklist draft:
```
1) Functional: traffic honors region tag and respects tenant slice mapping
2) Reliability: auto-failover to region-fallback under capacity pressure
3) Performance: P95 latency <= 300ms for region-local requests
4) Security: tenant data encrypted at rest with customer KMS keys
5) Ops: runbook + rollback playbook, and alerting for cross-region egress > $X/hr
6) Quality gate: evaluate output regression against baseline prompt set (A/B)
```

devin (prod): Add billing contract hook: pilot customers have a temporary egress cap and monthly credits.

emma (arch): Two design decisions to flag: 1) soft-eviction vs hard-isolate at cutover; 2) whether to require KV-prefetch for low-latency models. Both affect infra cost.

rick (sre): Soft-eviction preferred for pilot to avoid customer-visible failures. We'll implement throttled eviction with backoff.

sonia (cs): I'll prepare onboarding doc + support SLA. Need a simple matrix for which tenants get which slice.

maria (PM): I'll own the one-pager for execs. @emma please supply a short compatibility matrix for model variants and quantization profiles by EOW. @rick list SRE dependencies.

ops-bot: New RFC created: https://redwood.link/mr-isolation-pilot-rfc

emma (arch): Will post matrix today. Key note: some quantized variants have 5-8% quality delta on hallucination benchmarks — must pass eval gate.

devin (prod): Risks: bandwidth during cutover, and customer-visible latency spikes. Mitigations: staged canary + temporary traffic-shaping.

maria (PM): We'll include cost guardrails: hard egress cap and automatic pause if threshold exceeded. Also add telemetry to attribute cost to tenant and route.

sonia (cs): Customer wants weekly sync during pilot and a mid-pilot health review.

emma (arch): Implementation plan items for sprint 1:
- routing template DSL proto + policy enforcement hooks
- tenant slice metadata in config service

someone (devops): sprint 2:
- KMS per-tenant keybinding
- canary orchestrator + rollback API

rick (sre): sprint 3:
- circuit-breaker + cost-cap automation
- runbooks for rollback and evacuation

maria (PM): Great. I'll circulate the timeline and action items. Target: pilot kickoff in 8 weeks if all deps align.

devin (prod): :rocket: Sonia, loop the customer legal team for contract addendum.

sonia (cs): On it. Will send doc and invite.

emma (arch): One more ask - tie eval gating to CI so quantization regressions block rollout.

maria (PM): Added. Thanks all.
